source_claims.reading: Directions and sample format actually read: word, phrase or sentence missing, four choices, best answer. Official sample text/questions/answers not reproduced; our two single-gap documents are not a full official four-gap layout.

worked_examples.authorship: UniWay original four interview questions, fictional practice persona, weak/revised response and different-task response; two fictional Part 6 documents, eight choices, analyses and open transfer. Not ETS items, observed model output, student testimony, expert review or calibrated levels.
interview_checks: Q1 asks location AND reason; Q2 asks a specific change AND personal action; Q3 asks preference and explanation; Q4 asks a hypothetical campus resource priority. Four authored questions are not an official item-count claim.

Q3 revised answer chooses preparing alone FIRST, explains own reading pace and listing unresolved questions, then discusses those specific points with a classmate. Does not assert no collaboration, test scores or measured outcomes.
Q4 selects quiet desks as a hypothetical priority and preserves some group rooms; if/would wording preserves hypothetical status. Not a factual survey about any campus.

Examples are written teaching references; no recording supplied or fluency/pronunciation scored. Practice instructions explicitly distinguish listening-and-responding, reading questions, and reading model answers.

part_six_checks.support: Room 105 projector being repaired → move to Room 204 → change affects room only; time, registration, activities unchanged. Room 204 is legitimate added information, not required to appear earlier.

distractors.A: Cancels entire workshop despite retained time and activities.
distractors.B: Changes date to Friday despite room-only limit.
distractors.D: Cancels registration despite original registration still valid.

part_six_checks.support: Diagrams too small → enlarged in revised draft → review enlarged diagrams; comments before publishing, booking unchanged.

distractors.A: Already final and closed feedback contradict draft and before-publishing review.
distractors.C: All diagrams removed contradict enlarged diagrams in attached draft.
distractors.D: New booking website contradict booking procedure unchanged.

worked_examples.open_transfer: Past desk visit → introduced online booking form → can now reserve from home. Multiple coherent phrasings allowed; not official four-choice uniqueness or claim about an actual library.
worked_examples.arithmetic_and_scales: Official Part 6 4×4=16 checked; two original MC gaps each four choices=8 choices checked, not a full Part 6 paper. TOEFL scale 1–6 and 0.5 increments verified; no fees, deadlines, statistics, timed promises or practice-to-score conversion.
